arguments.command:
cd /app/work && cat > storetest.py <<'EOF'
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submission')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('entry','/app/submission/entry.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
Store = m.Store

class Ref:
    def __init__(self): self.d = {}
    def conflicts(self, off, data):
        for i,b in enumerate(data):
            o = off+i
            if o in self.d and self.d[o] != b: return True
        return False
    def store(self, off, data, keep):
        for i,b in enumerate(data):
            o = off+i
            if o in self.d and keep: continue
            self.d[o] = b
    def prefix(self):
        out = bytearray(); i=0
        while i in self.d:
            out.append(self.d[i]); i+=1
        return bytes(out)

random.seed(1234)
for trial in range(300):
    rs = Store(); rr = Ref()
    keep = (trial % 2 == 0)
    for step in range(60):
        n = random.randint(0, 12)
        if random.random() < 0.3:
            off = random.choice([0,1,127,128,129,255,256,random.randint(0,400)])
        else:
            off = random.randint(0, 10**18)
        data = bytes(random.randint(0,255) for _ in range(n))
        c1 = rs.conflicts(off, data); c2 = rr.conflicts(off, data)
        assert c1==c2, ('conflict mismatch', off, data, c1, c2)
        if not c1 or not keep:
            j = m.Journal(None)
            rs.store(off, data, j, keep)
            rr.store(off, data, keep)
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                j.rollback()
                # rebuild ref rollback: remove bytes that were newly stored
                # emulate: recompute by replaying history -- skip; instead compare after re-store
                pass
        assert rs.prefix() == rr.prefix(), ('prefix', off, data, rs.prefix(), rr.prefix())
    # check rollback integrity: store then rollback restores
    j = m.Journal(None)
    before = rs.prefix()
    snap = dict((k,(bytes(v[0]),v[1])) for k,v in rs.blocks.items())
    data = bytes(random.randint(0,255) for _ in range(random.randint(1,20)))
    off = random.randint(0,10**18)
    rs.store(off, data, j, keep)
    j.rollback()
    after = dict((k,(bytes(v[0]),v[1])) for k,v in rs.blocks.items())
    assert snap == after, ('rollback mismatch',)
    assert rs.prefix() == before
print('store tests OK')
EOF
